evidence.quote: DynamoDB reserved capacity is offered as either a one-year commitment or in select Regions as a three-year commitment. You can save up to 54% off standard rates for a one-year term and 77% off standard rates for a three-year term.
When you purchase DynamoDB reserved capacity, you pay a one-time partial upfront payment and receive a discounted hourly rate for the committed provisioned usage.
You can't sell, cancel, or transfer reserved capacity to another Region or account.
Reserved capacity is purchased in allocations of 100 WCUs or 100 RCUs.

claim: When you delete a table that has point-in-time recovery enabled, DynamoDB automatically creates a system backup and keeps it for up to 35 days at no additional cost.
question: What happens to a deleted table's data if PITR was enabled, and what does it cost?

evidence.quote: When you delete a table that has point-in-time recovery enabled, DynamoDB automatically creates a backup snapshot called a system backup and retains it for up to 35 days (at no additional cost).
